capabilities.title: Privacy-first web analytics: no cookies, no PII, GDPR-compliant pageview tracking
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Plausible core: cookieless tracking with aggregated metrics only
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a personal local dashboard; it does not run a public website requiring visitor analytics.

capabilities.title: Lightweight event tracking API: single JS snippet, POST endpoint for custom events
capabilities.reason: Nexus could adopt Plausible's lightweight event API pattern for internal usage telemetry (local only, no PII). Pending privacy model review.

capabilities.title: Aggregated metrics dashboard: unique visitors, pageviews, bounce rate, top pages
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Plausible dashboard: clean aggregated analytics UI
capabilities.reason: Nexus COMMAND could surface local usage metrics (most-used tabs, agent call frequency) using an aggregated dashboard pattern.

capabilities.title: Multi-site analytics SaaS platform with team dashboards
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Plausible cloud: multiple sites, team sharing, subscription billing
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a personal tool, not a multi-tenant analytics SaaS.
